fsm_states_sdram.name: Power Applied
fsm_states_sdram.description: Initial state at power-on; RESET_n LOW, supplies (VDD1/VDD2H/VDD2L/VDDQ) ramping in the defined order; device state undefined.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reset
fsm_states_sdram.description: RESET_n asserted LOW; internal logic reset; outputs high-impedance; mode registers cleared (must be re-programmed).

fsm_states_sdram.name: Initialization
fsm_states_sdram.description: After RESET_n deassertion + power stable + CK start: mode-register programming, ZQ calibration, and initial WCK2CK synchronization performed before normal operation.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Idle
fsm_states_sdram.description: All banks precharged, timing met, mode registers programmed. Ready to accept ACT-1/ACT-2, REF (ab/pb), MRW/MRR, SRE, PDE, or a CAS/WCK2CK sync sequence.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Refreshing (ab/pb)
fsm_states_sdram.description: All-bank (REFab) or per-bank (REFpb round-robin) refresh in progress; tRFCab / tRFCpb must elapse; in per-bank refresh, other banks remain accessible.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Self Refresh
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered via SRE over the CA bus; DRAM generates its own refresh; CKE pin does NOT exist — entry/exit is CA-command + CS bounded. Deep Sleep (DSM) is the deepest sub-mode (DSE bit).

fsm_states_sdram.name: Mode Register Access
fsm_states_sdram.description: MRW (two CA cycles, MA[6:0] + OP[7:0]) or MRR; tMRW/tMRD/tMRR honoured.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Activating
fsm_states_sdram.description: ACT-1 then ACT-2 latched; row opening in addressed bank / bank group; tRCD before the first column command.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Bank Active
fsm_states_sdram.description: One or more banks have an open row; ready for CAS (WCK sync) + RD/WR/MWR, further ACT (subject to tRRD_L/tRRD_S, tFAW), or PRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: WCK Synchronizing
fsm_states_sdram.description: After a CAS command carrying WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR: the DRAM locks its internal WCK phase to CK during the synchronization window before the high-speed transfer.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Reading
fsm_states_sdram.description: Read burst (BL16 / BL32) in flight; DRAM drives DQ and the RDQS read strobe at the defined read latency.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Writing
fsm_states_sdram.description: Write burst (BL16 / BL32) in flight; controller drives DQ + DMI framed by WCK at the defined write latency; Write-X (WRX) fills the burst without transferring data.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Precharging
fsm_states_sdram.description: PRE (bank / all-bank) in progress; tRP must elapse before another ACT or before MRW/REF/SRE.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Power-Down
fsm_states_sdram.description: Entered via a CA command (PD bit); lasts until CS next goes high; no CKE pin. Exit returns to Idle / Bank-Active.

fsm_states_sdram.name: Deep Sleep (DSM)
fsm_states_sdram.description: Lowest standby power; entered via SRE with the Deep Sleep Enable (DSE) bit; full re-initialization required on exit.

fsm_transitions_major.description: Supplies ramp in defined order; RESET_n held LOW.

fsm_transitions_major.trigger: RESET_n rising + power stable + CK start
fsm_transitions_major.target: Initialization → ZQ cal → WCK2CK sync → Idle
fsm_transitions_major.description: Mode-register program, ZQ calibration, initial WCK sync, then ready.
Two activate cycles open a row; tRCD before first column command.
CAS synchronizes WCK; RD drives DQ + RDQS at read latency.
CAS synchronizes WCK; WR samples DQ on WCK edges at write latency; WRX fills without data.
tRP before next ACT to that bank.
tRFCab / tRFCpb; per-bank refresh allows other-bank access.
CA command; DSE bit selects deep sleep; DRAM self-refreshes.
Self-refresh exit; deep-sleep exit requires full re-init.
Lasts until CS next goes high; no CKE.
Active-low reset returns the DRAM to its reset state.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_UP
fsm_states_controller.description: Hold RESET_n LOW; ramp VDD1 / VDD2H / VDD2L / VDDQ in the defined order; VDDQ to 0.5 V.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_INIT
fsm_states_controller.description: Deassert RESET_n; start CK; program mode registers (RL/WL, bank mode, WCK ratio, FSP, link ECC/DBI, ODT/Vref); run ZQ calibration; perform initial WCK2CK synchronization.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_IDLE
fsm_states_controller.description: Schedule REFab/REFpb to maintain refresh; track tREFI, tFAW; manage DVFS frequency set points.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_ACTIVATE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue ACT-1 then ACT-2 to open a row; respect tRCD, tRRD_L/tRRD_S, tFAW.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WCK_SYNC
fsm_states_controller.description: Before a transfer, issue CAS with WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR to lock WCK to CK; enable WCK only when needed.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_READ
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue RD / RD32 at the programmed read latency; receive DQ framed by the DRAM-driven RDQS; decode read link ECC; honour tCCD_L/tCCD_S.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_WRITE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue WR / WR32 / MWR at the programmed write latency; drive DQ + DMI framed by WCK; encode write link ECC; use WRX (all-0/all-1) where beneficial.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_PRECHARGE
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue PRE / PREab to close rows; wait tRP.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue REFab or REFpb (round-robin bank); wait tRFCab / tRFCpb; manage RFM if enabled.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_SELF_REFRESH
fsm_states_controller.description: Issue SRE (CA command); select deep sleep via DSE; on exit, restart clocks and (for deep sleep) re-initialize.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_DVFS
fsm_states_controller.description: Switch frequency set point (FSP); change WCK rate; adjust RL/WL/ODT/Vref; DVFSC selects VDD2H/VDD2L.

fsm_states_controller.name: CTRL_POWER_DOWN
fsm_states_controller.description: Enter power-down via a CA command (no CKE); the mode lasts until CS next goes high.

fsm_hints.trigger: Commands are committed on the 7-bit CA bus referenced to the quarter-speed CK (two CA transfers per command). The controller is the sole bus master; the DRAM never initiates a transaction. High-speed transfers require a prior WCK2CK synchronization (WS_FS/WS_RD/WS_WR via CAS).
fsm_hints.rule: LPDDR5 operates with deterministic latency; once a command is committed, data movement on DQ is fixed by read/write latency and burst length without any handshake. WCK and RDQS are enabled only when a transfer is imminent.
fsm_hints.abort: Bursts are not aborted by another command. RESET_n is the true abort; it asynchronously returns the DRAM to its reset state. Low-power entry is via CA command and persists until CS next goes high (no CKE pin).

anti_deadlock_rule: Controller shall honour all LPDDR5 timing parameters (tRCD, tRP, tRAS, tRC, tRRD_L/tRRD_S, tFAW, tCCD_L/tCCD_S, tRFCab/tRFCpb, tREFI, tWR, tWTR_L/tWTR_S, tRTP, tWCK2CK / WCK synchronization windows, tMRW/tMRD/tMRR, tZQ*, DVFS / FSP-change timings, deep-sleep entry/exit timings) between commands. Violating these causes undefined DRAM behaviour with no protocol-level error indication.
exit_from_reset_or_poweron: After power-on or RESET_n, the DRAM enters its reset state. The initialization sequence (RESET_n deassert, supply ramp ordering with VDDQ=0.5 V, CK start, mode-register programming, ZQ calibration, initial WCK2CK synchronization) must complete before any user data command. RESET_n must be HIGH throughout normal operation. Deep-sleep exit requires the full initialization sequence to be re-run.

default_ready_state_recommendation.CK_idle: Differential quarter-speed CK / CK_c running and stable in active states; may be stopped only in defined low-power windows.
default_ready_state_recommendation.WCK_idle: Disabled (not toggling) when no transfer is imminent; enabled only after WCK2CK synchronization — this is the key power-saving difference from a continuous data clock.
default_ready_state_recommendation.RDQS_idle: High-impedance / not driven except during reads (DRAM-driven).
default_ready_state_recommendation.CS_idle: Drives command framing; also bounds low-power-mode duration (mode lasts until CS next goes high).
default_ready_state_recommendation.RESET_n_idle: HIGH during normal operation; LOW only during reset.
default_ready_state_recommendation.DQ_idle: High-impedance between bursts (read direction quiescent); driven by controller during writes.

configurations.name: Bank-group mode
configurations.description: 16 banks as 4 bank groups × 4 banks; tCCD_L/tRRD_L same-group, tCCD_S/tRRD_S different-group.

configurations.name: 16-bank / 8-bank mode
configurations.description: 16 flat banks or 8 banks per density.

configurations.name: WCK on-demand
configurations.description: WCK enabled only after WCK2CK sync; saves power vs a continuous data clock.

configurations.name: DVFS / DVFSC
configurations.description: Frequency set points with VDD2H/VDD2L core-voltage scaling.

configurations.name: Deep Sleep (DSM)
configurations.description: Lowest standby power; full re-init on exit.

timing_dependency_rule: Command/address (CA[6:0], CS) inputs (referenced to Vref(ca)) are set up before and held after the CK edges (double data rate). DQ / DMI inputs (referenced to Vref(dq)) are set up before and held after both edges of WCK on writes. DQ outputs are launched edge-aligned with the DRAM-driven RDQS on reads. The internal WCK must be phase-locked to CK (via WCK2CK synchronization) before any high-speed transfer; the DFE / equalization settings must be trained for the active frequency set point.
